3456b8.risk_area: CORS Wildcard Origin + Excessive Data Exposure
3456b8.evidence: Endpoint returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * to all origins. Returns unauthenticated JSON with 23KB of sensitive application configuration including OAuth credentials, product data, challenge settings. Response status 200, repeatable with CORS origin header set to any domain.

6ee505.evidence: All endpoints /rest/*, /products/search, /admin/* return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * header. Enables cross-origin requests from any domain. All HTTP methods allowed: GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE. No credentials flag required (ACAC not set). Tested on 40+ endpoints - all return wildcard CORS header.

1e4dba.evidence: Tested 50 rapid sequential requests to /rest/admin/application-configuration. All requests returned HTTP 200 status with average response time 9ms. No HTTP 429 responses, no rate limiting headers, no throttling observed. Same result tested on /rest/products/search and /rest/user/whoami.

773b69.evidence: Endpoint accepts arbitrary field parameter: /rest/user/whoami?fields=password,email,role. Returns HTTP 200. No validation or filtering of requested fields observed. Tested with fields=['password','email','role','credit_card'] - all parameter variations accepted.

2ba9c9.evidence: Tested POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH on read-only endpoints /rest/admin/application-configuration, /rest/user/whoami, /rest/products/search. Unsupported methods returned HTTP 500 or 405. GET and HEAD methods return proper responses. Proper method handling confirmed.

afec2a.evidence: Discovered /rest/languages returns array of 42 language objects. Endpoint is functional but not exploitable - contains only language code/name pairs, no sensitive data. Tested for injection via language parameter - no vectors found.

47e506.evidence: Endpoints /graphql, /gql, /query respond with HTTP 200 but return HTML (main application page) not GraphQL responses. POST requests with JSON GraphQL queries also return HTML. GraphQL introspection not accessible via standard endpoints. Requires further investigation of correct GraphQL path or whether GraphQL is properly deployed.

71eab5.evidence: GET /api/BasketItems returns all basket items for all users (8 items from 3 different baskets). User 25 can access and manipulate basket data belonging to other users.

406cd4.risk_area: IDOR / Object-Level Authorization - Basket Item Deletion
406cd4.evidence: User 25 successfully deleted BasketItem 1 via DELETE /api/BasketItems/1 (status 200). Item access and deletion not restricted by ownership.

1b8d87.evidence: User 25 accessed User 26 basket items via GET /api/BasketItems?userId=26, returning all items. Server-side does not validate userId parameter against authenticated user.

235ce0.evidence: Successfully enumerated 26+ user accounts by iterating /api/Users/{id}. Identified admin users (IDs 1, 4, 10), accounting users, and deluxe users. All enumerable via sequential IDs without authentication.

0adf7e.evidence: Endpoint returns 500 errors. Implementation incomplete or blocked. Could not test for IDOR vulnerability due to lack of functional endpoint.

8b142b.evidence: Endpoint returns 500 errors. Could not test for IDOR vulnerability on payment methods. Implementation appears incomplete.

622420.evidence: Endpoint returns 500 errors. Could not test for IDOR vulnerability on delivery addresses. Endpoint not fully implemented.

535e35.evidence: Admin endpoints not implemented (return 500 Unexpected path errors). Cannot test access control on non-existent endpoints.

8920eb.evidence: Endpoint accepts PHP, EXE, and other executable extensions without validation. Tested with shell.php, malware.exe - all return 204 status (success). Content-Type spoofing works (image/jpeg MIME with PHP code accepted).

ad5806.evidence: Confirmed: Payload ' OR 1=1-- returns HTTP 200 with valid admin JWT token containing full user data (id=1, email=admin@juice-sh.op, role=admin, password hash). Working PoC with multiple SQLi patterns.

740c90.evidence: All weak passwords accepted: empty string, single character 'a', common words (password, test). No minimum length or complexity validation. HTTP 201 success on all test cases.

fb834f.evidence: No rate limiting detected after 15 consecutive failed login attempts. Each attempt returns 401 Unauthorized. No 429 status code, no Retry-After headers, no account lockout detected.

a84b4b.evidence: JWT payload contains sensitive data: user password MD5 hash, role (admin), email, timestamps. Token returned in response body, not as Set-Cookie. No HttpOnly flag possible. Decoded token shows plaintext credentials.

f44ec6.surface: Shopping cart manipulation - Price changes, quantity modifications
f44ec6.evidence: API endpoint /api/BasketItems requires authentication. Registration working via /api/Users endpoint. Could not complete dynamic testing due to API configuration returning 500 errors on auth endpoints. Requires further investigation with working auth flow.

249bb9.evidence: Tested multiple XSS payloads via URL parameters in search. Payloads are URL-encoded and not reflected unescaped in HTML responses. Angular application properly sanitizes/escapes search input before rendering.

d42b92.evidence: Tested XSS payloads in product category/filter parameters. Input properly encoded and not reflected unescaped in HTML.

49fa5e.evidence:
API endpoint exists with feedback comments. Existing feedback entries contain unescaped HTML tags (,
, ) in stored data, indicating HTML is not sanitized. However, submission requires CAPTCHA validation which prevents direct API submission. Frontend form submission could not be completed without bypassing CAPTCHA. Reachability of XSS payload execution unconfirmed - would require successful feedback submission followed by rendering verification.

7ea5d9.evidence: Reviews endpoint exists but is not publicly accessible without authentication. Cannot verify if reviews contain unescaped HTML without auth credentials.

4f9425.evidence: Tested Angular expression payloads ({{7*7}}, {{constructor.constructor(...)}}) via URL parameters. Expressions not evaluated - Angular application uses modern versions with expression injection protection.

d61157.evidence: Tested common redirect parameters (redirect=, url=, returnUrl=, next=, continue=). No redirect responses detected; application returns 200 with homepage regardless of parameter values.
